candidate_commit: FILL-IN: the 40-character commit id of the candidate tested
spec_revision: FILL-IN: the specification revision in spec.lock
started_at: FILL-IN: date-time with zone when the test or drill started
completed_at: FILL-IN: date-time with zone when it finished

data.term_start: FILL-IN: date-time with zone: Start of the current school term (date-time with zone, e.g. 2026-09-07T00:00:00+01:00)
data.release_at: FILL-IN: date-time with zone: Time this release candidate was cut (date-time with zone)

drills.name: FILL-IN: one of checkout, child_safety, cloud_failover, cloud_switch, content_correction, cost_spike, data_breach, halt, lan_restore, model_withdrawal, origin_usb, release, safety_configuration, school_update, signing_compromise, skill_pin, web_rollback: Runbook drilled
drills.owner: FILL-IN: text: Runbook owner (name or role)
drills.at: FILL-IN: date-time with zone: Time of the drill
drills.passed: FILL-IN: true or false: Did the drill pass?
drills.evidence_sha256: FILL-IN: the SHA-256 of this raw proof file, which is also listed in the index: the drill record (log, notes or recording)
drills.steps: FILL-IN: a list of strings: Steps followed (comma list of short step names)
drills.verification: FILL-IN: text: How success was verified (short)
drills.rollback: FILL-IN: text: How it was rolled back (short)
drills.offline_copy: FILL-IN: text: Where the offline copy of the runbook is kept

actions.due: FILL-IN: date-time with zone: Due (date-time with zone)

data.device: FILL-IN: Device or environment used: hardware class, model and asset label, OS version (or the staging environment name)
